sanskrit: adhunā devadeveśa pañcāśadvarṇamuttamamkṛpayā kathayeśāna yadyahaṃ tava vallabhāyena vijñātamātreṇa jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥsarvaṃ tasya vṛthā devi kiṃ tasya japapūjanaiḥvarṇajñānaṃ yadā nāsti kiṃ tasya japapūjanaiḥnānāvarṇayutaṃ śuddhaṃ tantrāṇāṃ sāramuttamamnānāvidyāmayīṃ devīṃ mahāvidyāmayīṃ tathāsarvadevamayīṃ saumyāṃ brahmāṇḍajananīṃ parāmakārādikṣakārāntā mātṛkā bījarūpiṇīvarṇāttu jāyate brahmā tathā viṣṇuḥ prajāyatemama kaṇṭhasthitā yā sā śāradā vāmalocanāvidhṛtya kaṇṭhadeśe tu śivo'haṃ kamalānaneśaraccandrapratīkāśaṃ pañcakoṣamayaṃ sadābindutattvamayaṃ varṇaṃ svayaṃ prakṛtirūpiṇībrahmaviṣṇumayaṃ varṇaṃ tathā rudraṃ svayaṃ priyeikāraṃ paramānandaṃ sugandhakusumacchavimsadā śaktimayaṃ devi gurubrahma svayaṃ tathāharibrahmātmakaṃ varṇaṃ guṇatrayasamanvitamīkāraṃ parameśāni svayaṃ paramakuṇḍalīpañcadevamayaṃ varṇaṃ pītavidyullatākṛtimukāraṃ parameśāni tāra kuṇḍalīnī svayampañcaprāṇamayaṃ devi caturvargapradāyakamśaṅkhakundasamākāraṃ svayaṃ paramakuṇḍalīpañcaprāṇayutaṃ varṇaṃ tathā trayaguṇātmakamdharmārthakāmamokṣaṃ ca sadā sukhapradāyakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: atra brahmā ca viṣṇuśca rudraścaiva varānanepañcaprāṇamayaṃ varṇaṃ caturjñānamayaṃ sadāṝkāraṃ parameśāni svayaṃ paramakuṇḍalīcaturjñānamayṃ varṇaṃ pañcaprāṇamayaṃ sadāḷkāraṃ cañcalāpāṅgi kuṇḍalī paradevatāpañcadevamayaṃ varṇaṃ caturjñānamayaṃ sadābindutrayātmakaṃ varṇaṃ pītavidyullatā yathāpañcadevātmakaṃ varṇaṃ pañcaprāṇātmakaṃ sadācaturvargapradaṃ devi svayaṃ paramakuṇḍalībandhūkakusumaprakhyaṃ pañcadevamayaṃ sadācaturvargapradaṃ devi svayaṃ paramakuṇḍalīkoṭicandrapratīkāśaṃ pañcaprāṇamayaṃ sadāsadāśivamayaṃ varṇaṃ bindutrayasamanvitamraktavidyullatākāraṃ triguṇātmānamīśvarametadvarṇaṃ maheśāni svayaṃ paramakuṇḍalīatra brahmādayaḥ sarve tiṣṭhanti satataṃ priyesadā īśvarasaṃyuktaṃ caturvargapradāyakampañcaprāṇātmakaṃ varṇaṃ brahmādidevatāmayamśaktitrayamayaṃ varṇaṃ svayaṃ paramakuṇḍalīaḥkāraṃ parameśāni raktavidyutprabhāmayamsarvajñānamayo varṇa ātmāditattvasaṃyutaḥśivasya yuvatī etā mūrttimat kuṇḍalī svayamrahasyaṃ paramāścaryaṃ trailokyānāṃ ca saṃśṛṇuadhorekhā bhavedrudro mātrā sākṣānmaheśvarījavāyāvakasaṃkāśā bāmarekhā varānane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: adhorekhā varārohe mahāmārakatadyutiḥkuṇḍalī aṅkuśā yā tu koṭividyullatākṛtiḥśūnyagarbhe sthitā kālī kaivalyapadadāyinīarthaśca jāyate devi tathā dharmaśca nānyathākakāraḥ kāmadā kāmarūpiṇī sphuradavyayāmātā sā sarvadevānāṃ kaivalyapadadāyinījñānārthā sātu cārvaṅgi kena catuṣṭayātmikākriyāśaktirbhaved rudraḥ sarvaṃ prakṛtimūrttimānāsanaṃ tripurādevyāḥ kakāraṃ pañcadevatāmtrikoṇametat kathitaṃ yonimaṇḍalamuttamamoṃ śayanāgārasindūrasadṛśīṃ kāminīṃ parāmkadambakorakākārastanadvayavibhūṣitāmratnahāraiḥ puṣpahāraiḥ śobhitāṃ parameśvarīmetatte kathitaṃ devi kakāratattvamuttamamkhakāraṃ paramāścaryaṃ śaṅkhakundasamaprabhamguṇatrayayutaṃ devi pañcadevamayaṃ sadāgakāraṃ parameśāni pañcadevātmakaṃ sadāpañcaprāṇamayaṃ varṇaṃ sarvaśaktyātmakaṃ priyeghakāraṃ cañcalāpāṅgi catuṣkoṇātmakaṃ sadānirguṇaṃ triguṇopetaṃ sadā triguṇasaṃyutamṅakāraṃ parameśāni svayaṃ paramakuṇḍalīpañcaprāṇamayaṃ varṇaṃ ṅakāraṃ praṇamāmyahamkuṇḍalīsahitaṃ devi svayaṃ paramakuṇḍalīpañcaprāṇamayaṃ varṇaṃ pañcaprāṇātmakaṃ sadāchakāraṃ paramāścaryaṃ svayaṃ paramakuṇḍalī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcaprāṇamayaṃ varṇaṃ triśaktisahitaṃ sadāpītavidyullatākāraṃ chakāraṃ praṇamāmyahamśaraccandrapratīkāśaṃ sadā triguṇasaṃyutamtriśaktisahitaṃ varṇaṃ tribindusahitaṃ priyeraktavidyullatākāraṃ sadā triguṇasaṃsthitamtribindusahitaṃ varṇaṃ triśaktisahitaṃ sadāraktavidyullatākāraṃ svayaṃ paramakuṇḍalītriśaktisahitaṃ varṇaṃ tribindusahitaṃ sadākoṭividyullatākāraṃ pañcadevamayaṃ sadātriśaktisahitaṃ varṇaṃ tribindusahitaṃ sadāpītavidyullatākāraṃ sadā triguṇasaṃyutamtribindusahitaṃ varṇaṃ triśaktisahitaṃ sādāpañcadevamayaṃ varṇaṃ pañcaprāṇamayaṃ sadācaturjñānamayaṃ varṇaṃ ātmāditattvasaṃyutamḍhakāraṃ paramārādhyaṃ yā svayaṃ kuṇḍalī parāraktavidyullatākāraṃ ḍhakāraṃ praṇamāmyahampītavidyullatākāraṃ pañcadevamayaṃ sadāātmāditattvasaṃyuktaṃ mahāmohapradāyakampañcadevātmakaṃ varṇaṃ pañcaprāṇamyaṃ tathātribindusahitaṃ varṇaṃ pītavidyutsamaprabhamtriśaktisahitaṃ varṇaṃ tribindusahitaṃ sadāaruṇādityasaṃkāśaṃ thakāraṃ praṇamāmyahampañcadevamayaṃ varṇaṃ pañcaprāṇamayaṃ sadāātmāditattvasaṃyuktaṃ svayaṃ paramakuṇḍalīdhakāraṃ parameśāni kuṇḍalī mokṣarūpiṇī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcaprāṇamayaṃ devi triśaktisahitaṃ sadāpītavidyullatākāraṃ caturvargapradāyakampañcadevamayaṃ varṇaṃ svayaṃ paramakuṇḍalīataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pakāraṃ mokṣadāyakampañcadevamayaṃ varṇaṃ svayaṃ paramakuṇḍalītruguṇai rahitaṃ varṇamātmāditattvasaṃyutamphakāraṃ śṛṇu cārvaṅgi raktavidyullatopamampañcaprāṇamayaṃ varṇaṃ sadā triguṇasaṃyutambakāraṃ śṛṇu cārvaṅgi caturvargapradāyakampañcaprāṇātmakaṃ varṇaṃ tribindusahitaṃ sadāsvayaṃ kuṇḍalinī sākṣāt satataṃ praṇamāmyahammahāmokṣapradaṃ varṇamaruṇādityasannibhamtriśaktisahitaṃ varṇaṃ tribindusahitaṃ priyearuṇādityasaṃkāśaṃ caturvargapradāyakamātmāditattvasaṃyuktaṃ hṛdisthaṃ praṇamāmyahampalāladhūmasaṃkāśaṃ svayaṃ paramakuṇḍalītriśaktisahitaṃ varṇaṃ tribindusahitaṃ tathāraktavidyullatākāraṃ pañcadevātmakaṃ sadātriśaktisahitaṃ devi ātmāditattvasaṃyutamlakāraṃ cañcalāpāṅgi kuṇḍalītrayasaṃyutampañcadevamayaṃ varṇaṃ pañcaprāṇātmakaṃ sadāātmāditattvasahitaṃ hṛdi bhāvaya sarvadāpañcaprāṇamayaṃ varṇaṃ triśaktisahitaṃ sadāpañcadevamayaṃ varṇaṃ pītavidyullatopamamtriśaktisahitaṃ devi triśaktisahitaṃ sadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: raktavarṇaprabhākārā svayaṃ paramakuṇḍalīpañcadevamayaṃ varṇaṃ pañcaprāṇātmakaṃ priyetriśaktisahitaṃ varṇamātmāditattvasaṃyutamraktacandrapratīkāśaṃ svayaṃ paramakuṇḍalīpañcadevamayaṃ varṇaṃ pañcaprāṇamayaṃ sadāsarvadevamayaṃ varṇaṃ hṛdi bhāvaya pārvatikoṭividyullatākāraṃ kuṇḍalītrayasaṃyutamrajaḥsattvatamoyuktaṃ tribindusahitaṃ sadāpraṇamya satataṃ devi hṛdi bhāvaya sundarikuṇḍalītrayasaṃyuktaṃ raktavidyullatopamampañcaprāṇātmakaṃ varṇaṃ triśaktisahitaṃ sadākṣakāraṃ śṛṇu cārvaṅgi kuṇḍalītrayasaṃyutampañcaprāṇātmakaṃ varṇaṃ triśaktisahitaṃ sadāśaraccandrapratīkāśaṃ hṛdi bhāvaya sundarisarvaṃ carācaraṃ viśvaṃ varṇāttu jāyate dhruvamvedañca smṛtiśāstrañca anyāni yāni kāni caataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi mantratattvaṃ pṛthak pṛthakataḥ paraṃ japenmantraṃ pañcāśanmātṛkāṃ pṛthakiti te kathitaṃ devi prayogaṃ mantramuttamamsarvaṃ tasya bhavedvyarthaṃ sarvaṃ vyarthakadarthanamtatastu praṇavaṃ dattvā mātṛkāṃ prajapet pṛthakpratyekamevaṃ cārvaṅgi daśadhā daśadhā japetathavā sarvavarṇānāmekīkṛtya varānanetathā ca sarvavarṇānāṃ dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi saṃśṛṇubhramadbhramaralīlābhāṃ nayanatrayarājitām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nānāvādyamayīṃ devīṃ śvetāṃśukapariṣkṛtāmbrahmāṇḍaṃ darpaṇe yasyā vāmahastasya pārvatievaṃ dhyātvā jagaddhātrīṃ mātṛkāṃ jagadambikāmsarvasiddhimavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇāyat kṛtvā sādhako yāti durlabhaṃ mokṣamavyayamrahasyaṃ śṛṇu cārvaṅgi sugopyaṃ bhuvanatrayeyasya mantrasya yaddhyānaṃ kṛtvā devi prayatnataḥiṣṭamantraṃ prajaptvā vai sarvasiddhiṃ tato labhetcaitanyarahitaṃ mantraṃ vidyā vā surapūjiteaparaṃ śṛṇu cārvaṅgi vargāṣṭakamanuttamamsarvaṃ tasya vṛthā devi ante ca narakaṃ brajetmantrasyādau ca ante ca akāraṃ bindusaṃyutamanena vidhinā devi ādityābhaṃ samācarettato mantraṃ varārohe dhruvaṃ jīvatvamāpnuyātjīvatvaṃ hi vinā devi yadi kuryāt puraścaramvargāṣṭakena sahitaṃ pratyahaṃ prajapet śatamkiṃ tasya dhyānapūjāyāṃ puraścaryāñca kiṃ punaḥvidyāyāśca tathā devi yaḥ kuryāt prāṇanirṇayamviśeṣataḥ kaliyuge jambūdvīpasya bhāratevaiṣṇaveṣu ca mantreṣu śaiveṣu śaktimantrakekiṃ tasya japapūjāsu homādiṣu ca kiṃ priyeprāṇatattvaṃ vinā devi dehanyāsaṃ karoti yaḥālokya tanmukhaṃ devi sūryadarśanamācaretyannoktaṃ sarvatantreṣu mātṛkāyāḥ pṛthak pṛthaksarvadevamayaṃ tattvaṃ sarvajñānamayaṃ tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvaśaktimayaṃ tattvaṃ sarvaprāṇamayaṃ tathākusumasya yadā devi kalikāṃ gandhasaṃyutāmpuṣpasya kalikāmadhye yathā jyotiḥ pradīpyatekoṭividyutpratīkāśāṃ mātṛkāṃ praṇamāmyahammātā sā sarvavidyānāṃ sarvāgamapratiṣṭhitāmātā sā gīyate devi pañcāśanmātṛkā ca sāpañcāśadyuvatīrūpā mātṛkā śavamavyayākuto brahmā kuto viṣṇuḥ kuto rudraśca īśvaraḥśavavat sarvadevāśca brahmāṇḍaṃ śavavat sadāśivamantraṃ yathā devi gaṇeśaṃ saurameva capurāṇañca tathā vedaṃ smṛtiśāstraṃ tathaiva cabrahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥsamastajananī devi mātṛkā jananī parāmātṛkāvarṇarahitaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ śavavat priyesarvaṃ hi yuvatīrūpaṃ dhyānamārge pratiṣṭhitamubhayoḥ saṃgamaṃ devi praphullaṃ bhavati priyeyanna mantreṣu vidyāsu praphullaṃ bhavati dhruvampraphullarahitaṃ devi vidyāmantraṃ yadi priyedhyātvā siddhimavāpnoti nānyathā surapūjiteyuvatī yā samākhyātā sā mahākuṇḍalī parāpañcāśadvarṇatattvaṃ ca vidyāmantraṃ japettu yaḥcaitanyarahitaṃ devi tajjapaṃ śavameva tatharirhi nirguṇaḥ sākṣāt saguṇā parakuṇḍalīsarvāsāṃ devadevīnāṃ bījaṃ janmasthalaṃ sadāata eva maheśāni brahmaṇaḥ kāraṇaṃ parā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāṇanyāsavidhiṃ kṛtvā japapūjāṃ karoti yaḥsa eva divyo vīraśca sa eva bhairavaḥ svayamsa sūryo devi pūjyaśca sadguruśca na cānyathāajñātvā tantrametattu japayajñaṃ karoti yaḥsarveṣu ca gururdevi śiṣyo'pi paśuvat sadāsikto bhavati cārvaṅgi kiṃ tasya japapūjanaiḥpūrvamantraṃ parityajya gṛhṇīyād gaṇanāparammantrasya gaṇanāddevi yat pāpaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥyat pāpaṃ prāpnuyād devi svayaṃbhūliṅgacālanetasmāttu gaṇanāṃ devi varjayenmatimānnaraḥanyat sarvāsu vidyāsu gaṇanāṃ varjayennaraḥyajjñātvā sādhako yāti durlabhaṃ brahmamandiramrecayet piṅgalāmārge prāṇāyāmakramāt priyepañcāśanmātṛkāvarṇaṃ sabinduṃ nādasaṃyutamtatastu mātṛkāvarṇaṃ vilomena japet priyeanulomavilomena mātṛkāṃ yuvatīṃ smaretanenaiva vidhānena recayet piṅgalāpathetrisandhyāṃ cañcalāpāṅgi yaḥ kuryāt kamalānaneekadhā vā maheśāni kalau saṃkhyā caturguṇāākāraṃ mukhatattvantu śṛṇuṣva varavarṇiniukāraṃ dakṣakarṇe syādūkāraṃ vāmakarṇakeḷkāraṃ dakṣagaṇḍaṃ syāt ḹkāraṃ vāmagaṇḍakamokāraṃ ūrdhvadantaṃ syāt aukāraścādhodantakamkakārādi pañcatattvaṃ dakṣabāhau praśasyatedakṣapāde ṭakārādi pañcatattvaṃ varānane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pakāraṃ dakṣapārśvañca phakāraṃ vāmapārśvakemakāraṃ udaraṃ tattvaṃ yakāraṃ hṛdayaṃ tathāghaṭitattvaṃ vakārañca śakāraṃ dakṣabāhuṣuvāmapādaṃ hakārañca kṣakāraṃ śirasoparimakārañca sakārañca maṇḍitaṃ hi tathaiva canakāraṃ śabdatattvañca daṃ dhaṃ rūpaṃ praśasyateukāramākāśatattvañca ūkāraṃ śrotrameva cakakāraḥ pṛthvītattvaṃ khakāro jñānatattvakamsakarāñca tathā candraṃ rakāraṃ vahnimaṇḍalamlakāraṃ pṛthvītattvaṃ hakārañca śirastathāetayoryogamāsādya kṣakāraṃ tattvavigrahamsarvatattvamatiguhyaṃ paramātmā sulocanebrahmāṇī caṇḍikā raudrī gaurīndrāṇī tathaiva cakālikā muṇḍamālā ca śivadūtī tathā parāśaṅkarī ca jayantī ca maṃgalā kalimardinībhīmā śāntā ca ugrā ca bhrāmarī rudrarūpiṇīdhātrīrūpā svadhā svāhā tathaiva vahnirūpiṇībrahmāṇḍavāṇī brāhmī ca pañcāśanmātṛkāḥ smṛtāḥetāstu mātṛkādevyo brahmāṇḍaṃ sacarācaramśaktimantre viṣṇumantre śaive saure ca pārvatimātṛkā yuvatīrūpā mantravigraharūpiṇīte sarve cañcalāpāṅgi niścalāśca nirindriyāḥśabdabrahma yadā yāti tantraṃ mantraṃ tadā bhavetbrahmaṇaḥ kāraṇaṃ nāsti prakṛterasti bhāvinidīkṣāyāṃ cañcalāpāṅgi praśastā yuvatīkalā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nirguṇaṃ paramaṃ brahma pradhānā yuvatīgaṇāḥdevīnāṃ jyotiṣaḥ puñjo vartante prakṛteḥ kalāḥvartante yuvatīrūpāḥ ṣoḍaśa prakṛ(tiḥ?teḥ) parāḥata eva varārohe sa eva śrīsadāśivaḥtāstāḥ sarvā varārohe yuvatī paramāparāśūnyāt śūnyaṃ paraṃ śūnyaṃ śūnyarūpaṃ nirañjanamhṛdi bhāvaya cārvaṅgi tejaḥpuñjaṃ mahāprabhamtribhaṅgalalitākāraṃ cārucūḍāvirājitampītāṃśukaparīdhānaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitamkadambakusumopetaṃ śravaṇaṃ janamohitamāraktanayanadvandvaṃ koṭividyutsamadyutimāraktakaratalasvacchaṃ guñjamālāvirājitamevaṃrūpaṃ samutpannaṃ hṛdi madhye varānaneśūnyamadhye sthitā devi kāmabījasvarūpiṇīsarveṣu viṣṇumantreṣu kāmabījaṃ parātparamtato vai kāmabījāttu jāyate viṣṇuvigrahamkāminī yā maheśāni viṣṇumātā pragīyatekakāraḥ kāminī sākṣād lakāraḥ pṛthivīśvarībinduḥ kuṇḍalinīrūpaṃ śivaśaktimayaṃ priyenirakṣaro viṣṇudevo hyakṣarājjāyate dhruvamklīṃkārabījarūpā yā sā parā parigīyatekāminī sā maheśāni pṛthivī tasya āsanamvasate kāminī devī bindutrayasamanvitāanena prajapenmantraṃ huṃkāraṃ varavarṇiniprakṛtiḥ paramārādhyā devānāṃ naganandini
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṣaṣṭhasvaraḥ paricayo viyadbījaṃ śaśiprabhamkāmamanmathakandarpam akṣaradhvajasaṃjñakammāyākūrcaṃ vadhūbījaṃ lakṣmībījañca pārvatisapiṇḍavattathā devi yeṣu yāsu ca vidyateevaṃ bījaṃ sakṛd dhyātvā sarvāsāṃ bhavati priyaḥevaṃ hi daśadhā kṛtvā mantrāṇāṃ bījasādhanamdevadhyānaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā iṣṭamantraṃ tato japetevaṃ hi daśadhā kṛtvā devādhiṣṭhānameva catanmantraṃ prajapeddevi evaṃ siddhimupālabheakṛtvā dhyānatattvañca aṣṭatattvaṃ tathaiva catato jīvatvamāpnoti mantraḥ sidhyati tatkṣaṇātpraṇavapuṭitaṃ kṛtvā anulomavilomataḥekadhā vā tridhā kṛtvā yadi kuryād varānanejīvatvaṃ hi vinā devi yadi mantraṃ japet sudhīḥsadā nidrāturo mantrī jīvahīnaśca pārvatijīvanyāsena cārvaṅgi nidrābhaṅgo bhaved dhruvamprāṇatattvañca cārvaṅgi devatattvaṃ tathaiva caakṣare akṣare devi ajñātvā prajaped yadikevalaṃ kalikābījaṃ tadvarṇaṃ surapūjitemataṃ śrīvāsudevasya iti te kathitaṃ priyeetanmantraprabhāvāddhi kālakūṭaṃ pibāmyahamete varṇā varārohe mahāyogamayāḥ sadāyogamārge bhaktimārge muktimārge ca sundarietāstu yuvatīvarṇāḥ kāryakāraṇarūpiṇaḥetanmantramavijñāya purāṇaṃ saṃhitāṃ smṛtim
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvadharmeṣu yatkarma sarvayajñeṣu yatphalamtatphalaṃ samavāpnoti varṇānāṃ dhyānamātrataḥpurāṇavācako yastu dhruvaṃ narakamāpnuyātyathā vaktā tathā śrotā dvayorapi phalaṃ samampurāṇāni paṭhitvā vai niścayaṃ narakaṃ vrajetniścayaṃ rogamāpnoti jambūdvīpasya bhāratesarvāsāṃ yuvatīnāñca bhavānī cādhidevatāraktapadmāsanagatāṃ raktāṃśukapariṣkṛtāmraktabimbaphalābhāsāṃ rākācandramukhīṃ parāmkaṭākṣaśatasaṃyuktāṃ cārucūḍāvinodinīmhāsyayuktāṃ praphullāsyāṃ jyotsnājālasamacchavimkañculīsaṃyutāṃ ramyāṃ kadambakorakastanīmevaṃ dhyātvā mahāmāyāṃ bhavānīṃ śivamohinīmhṛtpadme dvādaśadale varāhopari bhāvayetdhyātvādevīṃ yathāśaktyā tasmādāvirbhavet svayambījādutpadyate devi paraṃbrahma nirañjanamsadāśivo mahādevaḥ kathamutpadyate svayamiti yo vetti sa jñānī sa eva vīrasattamaḥsarveṣāñcaiva bījānāmevaṃ dhyānaṃ samācaretkaṭākṣaviśikhairyuktāṃ caturbāhusamanvitāmpuṇḍarīkopaviṣṭāñca rākācandramukhīṃ parāmnānābharaṇadīptāṅgīṃ meghāṃśukapariṣkṛtāmādyāṃ brahmamayīṃ devīmiṣṭabījasvarūpiṇīmbhaje'haṃ mātṛkādevīṃ vedamātā sanātanīmbījametanmaheśāni prathamaṃ daśadhā japet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tato dhyātvā punarjaptvā daśadhā varavarṇinisarvapāpamayaḥ so'pi bhavet śūkaravad dvijaḥtava bhaktyā mayākhyātamatiguhyaṃ sulocaneyogācāryo yogamāyā yogānandapradāyakaḥśṛṇu tattvaṃ pravakṣyāmi sundaraṃ sumanoharambhāvayenmantrabījāni yasya yā iṣṭadevatāanyāni sarvabījāni patramadhye pṛthak pṛthakdaśadhā daśadhā devi prajaped bījamuttamamtasmād bījād varārohe devatā jāyate dhruvamcaraṇāt keśaparyantaṃ nānāveśamayaṃ priyetatastu prajaped bījaṃ varṇānandasvarūpiṇametattu prathamaṃ bījaṃ sādhanaṃ durlabhaṃ priyedhyānaṃ paramakalyāṇaṃ varṇe varṇe pṛthak pṛthaktadevaṃ sahasā devi sarvāsāṃ jāyate dhruvambījāttu jāyate viṣṇuravatāravaraḥ priyesthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ devi sarvaṃ bījāt prajāyatesvādhiṣṭhāne tato devi maṇipūre ca pārvatipratyahaṃ kurute yastu sa siddhaḥ śiva eva saḥsādhanācca maheśāni tasmāt kusumavat priyebījasya cañcalāpāṅgi dhyānaṃ mantraṃ pṛthak pṛthaksanātanasya jananī sarvavarṇamayī priyetatastu prajapenmantraṃ sasetu varavarṇinisarvaṃ tasya vṛthā devi araṇye rodanaṃ yathāvibhāvya nābhipadmeṣu vāyubījaṃ sabindukamdhyātvā bījaṃ maheśāni prajaped bījamuttamam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: daśatattvayutaṃ mantraṃ tadaiva sahasā bhavethṛtpadme vahnimadhye tu dhyātvā bījaṃ hutāśanamviṃśatattvayutaṃ mantraṃ tadaiva sahasā bhavetāplāvya bījaṃ cārvaṅgi sarvāvayavasaṃyutamvaruṇasya tu madhye tu tadbījaṃ bhāvayet priyetadāmṛtamayaṃ bījaṃ sahasā bhavati priyeanyat sarveṣu mantreṣu bhāvayed varuṇālayetattvātītaṃ svadhātītaṃ vācā vidyāṃ japet priyetattvahīnaṃ japedyastu viphalaṃ satataṃ priyeetat tattvamayaṃ bhadre śīghraṃ siddhipradāyakamtasmāttattvaṃ śubhārādhya tasmānmantraṃ japet sudhīḥkṛṣṇamantreṣu rāmeṣu avatāravareṣu caśivamantreṣu cārvaṅgi anyatantre tathaiva caevameva vidhānena bīje jīvatvamāpnuyātutpadyante varārohe nānyathā varavarṇiniprajapedaniśaṃ vidyāṃ śaucāśaucaṃ na cācaretdevatāyāṃ varārohe pratimābuddhirjāyateiti te kathitaṃ devi bījatattvaṃ sugopanametajjñānamavijñāya sa kathaṃ gurutāṃ vrajetkṛpayā kathayeśāna vakāratattvamuttamamgāyatrī yā varārohe caturvakārasaṃyutāyavargaṃ vāyubījañca hṛdi bhāvaya pārvatiyakārasya caturtho yo vāyubījaṃ prakīrtitamsarvavidyāsu mantreṣu varuṇaṃ bhāvaya priyegāyatrī saṃsthitā devi pāpoccāṭanakarmaṇi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhyānabhedena cārvaṅgi vakāraṃ bhāvaya priyeviśeṣaṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi kakārasyātidurlabhamtad dhyātvā sādhako yāti durlabhaṃ mokṣamavyayamevaṃ taddhyānamātreṇa śivatulyo bhavennaraḥkakārabhāvanāccaiva sarvāsāṃ bhāvanā bhavetom prātarādityasaṃkāśāṃ siṃhapṛṣṭhoparisthitāmcaturbhūjāṃ trinetrāñca pañcabāṇadhanurdharāmmṛṇālasadṛśākāracaturbāhuparīvṛtāmsugandhimallikāhāraiḥ kabarīmadhyaśobhitāmśikhipucchayutāṃ cūḍāṃ nānāratnasamanvitāmmāṇikyakiraṇodyotadantapaṅktivirājitāmsvarṇasūtrayutahāraratnacāruvinirmitāmtīrthatrayayutāṃ ramyāṃ nayanatrayarājitāmbṛhallatāsusaṃyuktaratnakiñjalkaśobhitāmsindūratilakodīptāmañjanāṅkitalocanāmbrahmādidevatāvṛndaiḥ śirasi dhāryate ca yāevaṃ dhyātvā varārohe prajaped yadi sādhakaḥvarṇajñānaṃ vinā devi na japet pāśavaḥ kvacitkiṃ tasya japahomena candrasūryasya parvaṇiekadā noccareddevi ajñātvā vrṇadīpanīmsarveṣāṃ śāstramadhye tu praśastā varṇadīpanījñātvā tantraṃ prakurvīta dīkṣāṃ pūjāṃ śucismiteyatkṛtvā sādhako yāti paramaṃ padamuttamamkarpūrāgurukastūrīrocanākuṅkumaiḥ priyetrikoṇaṃ sundaraṃ svacchaṃ tilakaṃ janamohanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rājyārthī raktavarṇena mokṣārthī śvetacandanaiḥmohane cañcalāpāṅgi agurukuṅkumādinālalāṭe bāhumūle ca tathā skandhadvayeṣu caūrudvaye gaṇḍayugme adhaḥ pādadvayeṣu cacandravinduyutaṃ kṛtvā vilikhed varavarṇinimohayedakhilān lokān vaśayediṣṭadevatāmtatkṣaṇāccañcalāpāṅgi devatvamupajāyateanyathā pretavat pūjā vaiṣṇave ca viśeṣataḥtanmadhye vilikhed varṇaṃ kakāraṃ sumanoharametattu tilakañcaiva vaśayedapi keśavamsa bhraṣṭaḥ sa ca pāpiṣṭho rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajethṛttatvaṃ kathayeśāna yadyahaṃ tava vallabhāyena vijñānamātreṇa viṣṇuḥ syād vaiṣṇavaḥ priyekakāraṃ bhāvayedādau varāṭopari pārvatimantrāṇāṃ prathamaṃ bījaṃ dhyātvādau prajapet sudhīḥdevatāñca tato dhyātvā tantroktadhyānavartmanākṛtvā dhyānatrayaṃ devi hṛtpadme parameśvarisvavidyāṃ bhāvayeddevi koṭividyutsamākṛtimjāyante devi bījāttu rāmakṛṣṇādayaśca yejñātvā sanātanaṃ tattvaṃ ānandapaṭale sthitamidaṃ sanātanaṃ tattvamajñātvā narakaṃ vrajetrauravaṃ narakaṃ yaṃ yaṃ taṃ tamāpnoti niścitamubhayornarakaṃ devi koṭikulasamāyutamyadi śūdro bhaveddevi satyavādī jitendriyaḥsarvasiddhimavāpnoti śīghraṃ devamavāpnuyāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: taddeśaṃ patitaṃ manye tasya rājā ca pātakītasya jihvā varārohe mūtraśoṇitaviḍyathātajjalaṃ śoṇitaṃ sākṣāccāṇḍālasamajātiṣuālokya tanmukhaṃtīrthaṃ tatsthānaṃ tyajya(?)gacchatigaṅgājalaṃ parityajya drutaṃ svasthānamavāpnuyāttrailokyapāvanī gaṅgā tān punāti na saṃśayaḥkalau tu bhārate varṣe bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥtatsaṃsargaśca yo vipraścarmakāraḥ sa eva hisvadharmanirataḥ sūdro vidyāmantraṃ śṛṇoti yaḥetatte kathitaṃ devi varṇajñānavinirṇayamyatkṛtvā cañcalāpāṅgi rāvaṇādyā niśācarāḥsāṃketaṃ paramaṃ guhyamakṣarāṇāṃ pṛthak pṛthakpañcāśadvarṇasaṅketaṃ sāvadhānāvadhārayarauravaṃ narakaṃ yāti punarāvṛttidurlabhamakṛtvā vaiṣṇavo yāti narakaṃ koṭikoṭiśaḥprātaḥ snānaṃ samāsādya kṛtvā sandhyāṃ samāpya cayāgamaṇḍapamāsādya bhūtaśuddhiṃ vidhāya canyāsānanyāṃstataḥ kuryāttantramārgeṇa pārvatiraktāsanaṃ samāsādya kuśāsanamathāpi vāvilikhya mātṛkāvarṇaṃ hyasmin pātre pṛthak pṛthakmahāpadmāntarasthānādānīya brahmavaktrakamtatpuṣpaṃ cañcalāpāṅgi kuryāt puṣpasya sañcayamgandhairnānāvidhairdevīṃ puṣpairnānāvidhaistathānaivedyaṃ vividhaṃ devi caturvidhamayaṃ tathānānāpuṣpamayairhāraiḥ śukrādigandhasaṃyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prajaped mātṛkāvarṇaṃ varṇe varṇe pṛthak pṛthaktasmin padme vanāntasthaḥ svavidyāṃ prajapecchatamakṛtvā mātṛkāpūjāṃ māsi māsi varānanecitrānāḍīgatā bhūtvā mātṛkā jagadīśvarīśaivānāñca maheśāni anyeṣāñcaiva sundaripraśastā mātṛkāpūjā dīkṣā yā matta eva himātā sā sarvavidyānāṃ mantrāṇāñca pṛthak pṛthaktasmāttu yatnato devi tāsāṃ pūjā vidhīyateanena vidhinā devi pūjayed yadi mātṛkāmrahito mātṛkāpūjāṃ japapūjanatatparaḥharanti mantratejāṃsi āyurvidyāyaśobalamanulomavilomena kathitaṃ śṛṇu pārvatisarveṣāṃ japayajñānāṃ sahasā phalabhāg bhavetsahasā arthamāpnoti sahasā mokṣamāpnuyātyaḥ karoti prasannātmā sa eva śrīsadāśivaḥrahasyametadanyacca sarvañca viphalaṃ vrajetna devo vidyate kāṣṭhe na pāṣāṇe ca pārvatidivyabhāvo vīrabhāvaḥ sadaiva sahasā bhavetsvabhāvena vinā devi kathaṃ siddhirbhavet priyeanenaiva vidhānena mātṛkāṃ pūjayettu yaḥsa dhanī guṇī loke mātṛkāṃ yastu pūjayetpūrvoktadhyānamācarya prajapenmātṛkāmanumjaptvā kakāraṃ cārvaṅgi sarvāsāṃ bhavati priyaḥkakāraṃ sarvavarṇānāṃ mūlaprakṛtirūpiṇīmpratyahaṃ pūjayeddevīṃ prathamaṃ pūjayet sudhīḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kakārapūjanād bhadre sarvāsāṃ pūjanaṃ bhavetdivyavīraḥ sa eva syāt sarvapūjāphalaṃ labhetsarvapūjāmayaḥ so'pi sarvabhāvamayaḥ sadāśaktimantraṃ maheśāni sa kathaṃ pāmaro japetbhāvatattvaṃ vinā devi prajapedyadi koṭidhāsa kathaṃ cañcalāpāṅgi divyavīragururbhavetbhāvatattvena rahitaḥ sa kathaṃ pañcamaṃ yajetdevatāyā varārohe śarīraṃ jāyate dhruvamkālīṃ chinnādividyāñca triṃśadvarṇamayīṃ sadāiṣṭadhyānaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā hṛdi madhye nirīkṣaṇampraphullādhyānamātreṇa jāyate devavigrahamtadiṣṭaṃ bhāvayed devi mantroktadhyānavartmanāmantrasya prathamādbījājjāyate naganandinitasmāttu yuvatīdehājjāyate kṛṣṇavigrahambījādutpadyate devi paraṃ brahma sanātanamaparaikaṃ pravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ paramādbhutamvarṇatattvaṃ vinā devi prajapedyadi koṭidhāhṛtpadme dvādaśadale varāṭopari kāminīmakārādikṣakārāntaṃ trikoṇamadhyamaṇḍaleekaikaṃ bhāvayed devi prativarge pṛthak pṛthakdhyātvā prayatnato devi anulomavilomataḥyaḥ karoti naro jñātvā śīghraṃ vidyā prasīdatiṣaṭcakre parameśāni rahasyaṃ sthānamuttamampañcāśadvarṇasaṅketaṃ yaḥ kuryānmānavaḥ priyemohayeccañcalāpāṅgi rudraṃ kālānalaprabham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: etatte kathitaṃ devi varṇamohanamuttamamtasmai lokā gandharvāśca vairabhāvaṃ brajanti vaiajñātvā mohanaṃ tattvaṃ yaḥ kuryādanyamohanametattatvaprabhāvāddhi acirāt siddhimāpnuyātjapitvā varṇamekañca svasthānamānayecca tamprajapedakṣaraṃ devi candrabindusamanvitamanena vidhinā devi yo japenmantramuttamamsambhāvaṃ likhitaṃ devi yathā bhavati akṣaramviśeṣamantraṃ vakṣyāmi ānandapaṭale sthitamjñātvā yaḥ kurute devi tasya siddhiradūrataḥajñātvā vaiṣṇavo yāti rauravaṃ varavarṇininavatattvamayīṃ vidyāṃ yadā japati pārvatinavatattvayutaṃ mantraṃ jñātvā yaḥ prajapet sakṛtprathamaṃ kāminīṃ dhyātvā hṛtpadme kamalekṣaṇepunarbījaṃ dvitīyañca uccared yatnataḥ sudhīḥanena vidhinā devi kāminīdhyānasaṃpuṭamanulomaṃ yathā devi vilomañca tathā kurukṛtvā yatnād varārohe sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavetādyante kāminīṃ dhyātvā śivaśaktimayo bhavetādau madhye tathā cānte bījaṃ dattvā japet priyesadā nidrāturo mantraḥ kalikāle ca bhāratejapedādau varārohe trivāramanulomataḥathānyat saṃpravakṣyāmi nidrābhaṅgasya lakṣaṇamdaśadhā prajapenmantraṃ nidrābhaṅgāya pārvatirahasyanena cārvaṅgi jāyate viṣṇuvigraham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pītāmbaradharaṃ śāntaṃ prasannaṃ mukhapaṅkajamtribhaṅgalalitākāraṃ cārucūḍāvibhūṣitamavatāraṃ svayaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ lalitāñjanacikkaṇamathavā jāyate devi tasmādbījācchucismiterahasyametaccārvaṅgi kartavyaṃ hṛdi madhyataḥathānyat saṃpravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ paramādbhutamtadgarbhe bhāvayenmantraṃ manasā naganandinipunaśca kāminīṃ dhyātvā tasmādāvirbhaved hariḥnidrāyuktaṃ maheśāni vidyāmantraṃ bhavet sadājapāt koṭiguṇaṃ bhadre sahasā labhate dhruvamcalate ca yadā bāhordakṣiṇe varavarṇiniata eva varārohe tyaktanidraṃ japet sudhīḥtatkathaṃ sidhyate mantraḥ kiṃ kartavyaṃ tadā prabhorahasyamantraṃ vakṣyāmi ānandapaṭale sthitamrahasyamantraṃ cārvaṅgi ajñātvā viphalaṃ bhavetsahasā kāminīṃ dhyātvā turīyakūṭamuccaretprajaped daśadhā devi hṛdaye manasāpi vāprāyaścittaṃ bhavettasya mantrasya varavarṇinikiṃ tasya dakṣiṇo bāhustasya nidrātureṇa kimrahasyametaccārvaṅgi sarvanidrāsu maṅglamrahasyametaccārvaṅgi kṛtvā tu prajapenmanumyoganidrāmayī vidyā yoganidrāmayo manuḥaṣṭākṣarīṃ mahāvidyāṃ dīpanīṃ mokṣarūpiṇīmprajaped yadi nidrāyāṃ kiṃ tasya japapūjanesuṣumṇāmadhyamārgeṣu saṃsthitā brahmarūpiṇī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tasya pāpamahaṃ vakṣye sāvadhānāvadhārayayaṃ yaṃ narakamāpnoti taṃ taṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥkoṭivaṃśān samādāya pacyante manujādhamāḥpacyante narake ghore śūdrasya likhanāt priyetasmādāvaśyakaṃ devi kāminīdhyānamuccaretkāminīdhyānamātreṇa sarvasiddhimayo bhavettava bhaktyā mayākhyātaṃ yadgopyaṃ bhuvanatrayesaphalā sā bhavet pūjā japañca saphalaṃ sadāprathamaṃ kāminīṃ dhyātvā japapūjāṃ samācaretviṣṇurūpī sa eva syānmahāmāyā sa eva hikāmadhenumidaṃ mantraṃ praśastaṃ surapūjiteyat kṛtvā sādhako yāti durlabhaṃ mokṣmandiramajñātvā kāminīdhyānaṃ sahasā vyarthatāmiyāttasmādavaśyaṃ japtavyaṃ satataṃ kāmadīpanīmkasmai samarpayenmantraṃ vada deva purātananistejā sādhako deva tadaiva sahasā bhavettanme vada mahābhāga kṛpayā parameśvarajapitvā cañcalāpāṅgi dhyāyet paramakāminīmcandrabinduyutaṃ kṛtvā ekaikaṃ daśadhā japetataḥ paraṃ varārohe jñātvā tu kāminīṃ parāmkāminīgarbhamadhye tu viyadvahniyutaṃ priyetatastu kāminītattvaṃ lalāṭe paricintya vaipañcāśanmātṛkāsthāne prajapenmātṛkāmanumdaśadhā prajaped devi kāminībījamuttamamjyotistattvaṃ varārohe svayaṃ jīvaḥ sanātanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sahasrāre mahāpadme saṃsthāpya kāminīṃ parāmdevasya dakṣiṇe haste bāhyapūjādi cārpayetjapasya sarvatejāṃsi devahaste yadi priyekiṃ tasya pūjane bhadre kiṃ jāpena varānanevidyāmantraṃ japed devi tatteja upajāyatenārpayeccañcalāpāṅgi devyā haste viśeṣataḥjīvatattvaṃ vinā devi yadi devaṃ samarpayetgandhapuṣpādikaṃ yadyat sarvaṃ deve samarpayetyadi tejo varārohe devyai devāya arpayetyastejastvarpayed devi punarāgamanaṃ priyevṛthā bhayaṃ varārohe kurute narapāmaraḥdevatātejamadhye tu tattejopaviśet priyeetatte kathitaṃ devi jīvatattvaṃ sudurlabhamtantrametad varārohe śṛṇuyāt sādhakaḥ priyetadaiva sahasā siddhirjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥtatastu kāminīṃ japtvā sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavetna japed grahaṇe bhadre ajñānād yadi mūḍhadhīḥcandraparva sūryaparva na vicāryaṃ kadācanaastu tāvat paro dharmaḥ pūrvadharmo vinaśyatisarvāriṣṭamayaḥ so'pi sarvapāpamayaḥ sadāsūryaparva tathā devi nirīkṣyamokṣamāpnuyātvicārya cañcalāpāṅgi na paśyed grahaṇaṃ yadicandrasūryoparāgañca tasmād yatnānnirīkṣayetgrāsādimuktiparyantaṃ japtvā siddhīśvaro bhavettatkāle cañcalāpāṅgi paraṃbrahmasvarūpiṇī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ācaṇḍālaprabhṛtayo dvijatulyā bhavanti hitatra kā gaṇanā devi cāṇḍālānāṃ varānanecandrakoṭiguṇaṃ devi sūryo daśaguṇaṃ bhavetakṣayaṃ tad bhaved devi vacanaṃ mama niścitamyavanasya tathā siddhirjāyate pṛthivītaletadevamakṣayaṃ snānaṃ gaṅgāsnānaṃ bhavet priyepraśastaṃ grahaṇe kāle nānyathā vacanaṃ mamagrahaṇe candrasūryasya tasya snānaṃ praśasyatesa bhraṣṭaḥ sa ca pāpiṣṭhaḥ sahasā sūkaraḥ priyejāyate nātra sandeho mama vākyaṃ varānanecāṇḍālaprabhṛtiḥ sarvo brahmagotre pravartatetasmāttu cañcalāpāṅgi saṃkalpaṃ naiva kārayetna vicāryaṃ varārohe grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥsa kālaḥ paramaṃ brahma sarveṣāmakṣigocaramuparāgaṃ parityajya yaścānyaṃ paricintayetrauravāt punarāgatya pāpayonau pravarttatetasmāt sarvaṃ parityajya candraparvanirīkṣaṇamtatra śrāddhādikaṃ tyaktvā vidyāṃ mantraṃ japet priyeaparaikaṃ pravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ śṛṇu sundaritatastu prajapet śūnyaṃ candrabindukasaṃyutamanulomavilomena mātṛkāṃ prajapet sudhīḥpadmabījaṃ yathā devi varṇabījaṃ prabhāvayetanulomavilomena japtvā'mṛtamayo bhavettatastu devatāṃ dhyātvā nirīkṣya devavigraham....ṣyāṃ ca varārohe gaṅgāyāṃ snānamityaham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00133 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: arko dharmapayo devi amādyarthaśca mūrtimānvyatīpāte maheśāni svayaṃ muktiḥ pragīyateetattu kathitaṃ devi pañcayogaṃ parātparamtatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti gaṅgādarśanamātrataḥtatastu mauśalaṃ snānaṃ koṭisūryagrahaiḥ samamācamya cañcalāpāṅgi vāsaṃ kuryād viśāladhīḥyadi pucchaṃ japenmantraṃ harettejāṃsi tanmukhamcañcale sati cārvaṅgi tajjapaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavetsthāpyākṣarāṇi pūrve vai sumeruṃ pucchaṃ tarpiṇammālārahasyaṃ cārvaṅgi sugopyaṃ bhuvanatrayejīvamantraṃ pravakṣyāmi sāvadhānāvadhārayayathā dhyānaṃ maheśāni samānaṃ yāti jīvanedvibhujāṃ svarṇagaurāṅgīṃ pītapaṭṭaparicchadāmkṛṣṇagandhapraliptāṅgīṃ sūryāsanakṛtāśrayāmkadambakorakākārastanadvayavirājitāmkaṭākṣalakṣasaṃyuktabhūlatāpariśobhitāmsarvatraivaṃ maheśāni jīvaṃ tiṣṭhati sarvadāetatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kāmadhenormataṃ priye
